items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: I play in the Carnegie Hall band that Jon Faddis leads

ctx.x: And what’s your weeks like these days? Playing different kinds of things now?

Well I still have — a variety of stuff happens, it’s wonderful. I play in the Carnegie Hall band that Jon Faddis leads, and we do four concerts a year in Carnegie Hall and then we’ve been getting some more outside work. We went to Japan year before last for a week to a festival. And we went to South America this past November for ten days and we’re going to Mexico City in a couple of weeks. And we do some of the festivals in Europe in the summer, the well traveled path. And more and more stuff is coming up. And…
Talk to him, yeah. Who else is playing in that group?
